Padma Awards conferred on prominent Indian figures

President Droupadi Murmu presented the Padma Awards, India's second-highest civilian honour, to a number of distinguished individuals. Among those recognized were actor Mammootty, singer Alka Yagnik, cricketer Rohit Sharma, and former tennis player Vijay Amritraj. The ceremony took place at Rashtrapati Bhavan, with some recipients attending with family members.
